graders.name: duplicates-removed
graders.criteria: packages/web/CLAUDE.md no longer restates rules the root CLAUDE.md already gives: pnpm only, no new dependencies without asking, strict TypeScript / no `any`, conventional commits, and running `pnpm -r lint` and `pnpm -r test` before finishing.

graders.name: default-export-exception-kept
graders.criteria: packages/web/CLAUDE.md still states that Next.js route files (page.tsx, layout.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx) must use a default export, as an exception to the named-exports rule. Dropping the general 'use named exports' half is fine since the root file states it; dropping the exception is not.

graders.name: web-specific-rules-kept
graders.criteria: The web-only guidance is kept with its meaning: the app router (the Next.js version may be dropped, since the root CLAUDE.md states Next.js 14); server components by default with "use client" only for state, effects or browser APIs; Tailwind, no CSS modules or styled-components; all data fetching through lib/api.ts, never fetch directly in components.
